dialogues.speaker: Sal
dialogues.text: For my dream, which is to open up my very own shop. It doesn't need to be big, it just needs to make enough money for me to get by on.

dialogues.speaker: Sal
dialogues.text: I'm used to hard labor and have a decent enough head for business. Not that I hope to be as promising as Jut. All I want is a stable life.

dialogues.speaker: Sal
dialogues.text: A lot of cargo ships have been coming in and out of Sumeru lately. Those merchants from Snezhnaya are especially willing to spend money to have workers move their goods.

dialogues.speaker: Sal
dialogues.text: If this keeps up, it shouldn't be long before my dream of opening up a store can become a reality.
